scope: Read-only audit of actual immutable C1 Git objects and observed branch heads; no scientific file, index, remote ref or workflow was mutated. Blob hashes/modes/lengths were compared; all remote blob bodies were not downloaded.
branch_scope: GitHub branch refs (heads); the baseline is not a tags inventory.
moving_head_scope: These C1 head observations are not assertions about a later C2/C3 head. C1 commit/tree objects remain the immutable audit target.
timestamp_scope: First four actual GETs lacked per-call timestamps; their raw responses are preserved and timestamps are null rather than fabricated.
